args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (unhealthy, error rate ~18% across us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified: us-east, us-west, eu-west all on v2.3.0. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging prior to release. Follow-up: root-cause v2.3.1 failure before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **What failed:** v2.3.1 was live in us-east, us-west and eu-west and failing health checks, with about 18% of requests erroring.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback all three regions are on v2.3.0, health checks pass, and the error rate is about 0.2%.
- **Incident INC-0001:** It describes the v2.3.1 failure, the rollback to v2.3.0 and the confirmation that all regions are on it. It also notes that the v2.3.1 release candidate was already unhealthy in staging before it went to production. The follow-up is to find the root cause before v2.3.1 is deployed again.

I opened the incident at the same time as the final health check, so it doesn't include the post-rollback error rate. You may want to add it.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
